scenarios.theme: The index works for one status but sorts heavily for all statuses. What will you change?
scenarios.assumptions: An index on tenant/status/created_at supports a single-status feed. A new page needs all statuses for one tenant in global recent-first order, with a small LIMIT. What will you do?

scenarios.theme: A query filters only a later key. Is adding another index always necessary?
